**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000 – $850 000  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $950 000 – $1 050 000  

> *The median figure is the most commonly cited “average” for U.S. real‑estate reports. It represents the middle value of all home sales in the state, so half of the homes sold for less than this amount and half sold for more. The mean (average) is slightly higher because a handful of very expensive properties pull the arithmetic mean upward.*
